en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。

ja: 指揮者のために。コラの子らの詩。

p.src: 1  Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

en: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
u.src: 1  Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

p.src: 2  For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

en: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
u.src: 2  For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

p.src: 3  He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

en: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
u.src: 3  He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

p.src: 4  He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

ja: は私たちのために相続地を
されたヤコブの栄光を。 セラ。
en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
u.src: 4  He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

p.src: 5  God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

ja: は喜びの叫びと共に上られ、 主は角笛の音と共に
en: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
u.src: 5  God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

p.src: 6  Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
u.src: 6  Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

p.src: 7  For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

en: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
u.src: 7  For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

p.src: 8  God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

en: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
u.src: 8  God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

p.src: 9  The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

ja: まり、 アブラハムの
en: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
u.src: 9  The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
